description: This file defines the LineGetter class used for extracting line element information from a PDF content stream, including methods for parsing and retrieving line coordinates.

classes.name: LineGetter
classes.description: A class that iterates over content stream elements to find and extract line information.

classes.name: LineGetter.LineInfo
classes.description: A class that holds the start and end coordinates of a line, with methods to create instances from string inputs.

methods.name: IdentifyingElementCheck
methods.description: Checks if a given element is the identifying 'l' element.

methods.name: GetObject
methods.description: Retrieves the line information by navigating the content stream backwards from an 'l' element.

methods.name: CreateLineInfo
methods.description: Static method to create a LineInfo object from string coordinates, parsing them into doubles.
